relationships.rationale: Decision step 2 (aggregation): the hazard raster is the annual nowcast count of LHASA 1.1, averaged over the IMERG years; the exposure rasters multiply it by population, road and infrastructure density. "LHASA 1.1" mapped to Global_Landslide_Nowcast 1.1 (the 1.1 README cites the same paper for the 1.0→1.1 changes).

metadata_findings: The only MetadataAssociation points to the record itself (Global_Landslide_Nowcast 1.1) and has no Type; it should be removed or replaced with the lineage below.
The DATA SET LANDING PAGE (https://www.earthdata.nasa.gov/data/catalog/ges-disc-sndrsnml2rmssup-3) is the landing page of an unrelated dataset.
Platforms is ['MODELS'] only; the input missions (GPM) are not recorded.
Neither the record nor the README names the IMERG product (run and time step) that drove the nowcast; NHESS says only "IMERG (version 6B)".
The README's model reference, Kirschbaum & Stanley (2018), could not be read (publisher returned HTTP 403).

excluded.detail: NHESS names "IMERG (version 6B)" only; Early, Late and Final runs at 30-min and daily steps all exist (rules 1c-3, 1c-6).
ATBD text says "IMERG Early Product … 30 min"; its dataset citation names the Late daily product, which is written.
NHESS: "Gridded Population of the World version 4 ... adjusted to the UN WPP Population Density for 2015"; the revision is not stated.
Other versions of the target are never listed (Generation Skill 1a, version_of); a row would be a self-relation.
